class.name: HTMLLinkElement
class.brief_description: A link to an external document resource.
class.description: Represents [code]<link>[/code]. Dockit loads local and absolute HTTP(S) stylesheets for [code]rel="stylesheet"[/code]. Local stylesheet text and dependencies can be baked into an imported [HTMLDocument]. HTTP(S) stylesheets load asynchronously and [member sheet] becomes available after a successful response. Changing [member href] discards previously edited CSSOM rules. Changing [member media] or [member disabled] preserves the associated stylesheet ID and rules.

method.name: get_resolved_href
method.description: Resolves [member href] against the current document base URL.

method.name: get_stylesheet_id
method.description: Returns the layout's CSSOM ID for the associated stylesheet, or [code]0[/code] if there is no associated sheet. Use the ID with [method HTMLLayout.get_css_rules], [method HTMLLayout.insert_rule], and [method HTMLLayout.delete_rule].

members.member: Reflects the boolean [code]disabled[/code] attribute. An initially disabled link loads its stylesheet when enabled for the first time.
The media query list that controls when the stylesheet applies.
The raw list of link relationship tokens.
The associated stylesheet, or [code]null[/code] when no stylesheet is associated.
The declared MIME type of the linked resource.
